meta.title: Knowledge Base
meta.description: Keep your documents in one place and ask questions answered from them, with the sources linked.

shell.signOutFailed: Couldn't sign you out. Check your connection and try again.

auth.statement: Answers from your own documents, with the sources to prove it.
auth.supporting: Add notes, PDFs and text files, then ask in plain language. Every answer links back to the passages it came from.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Use the email and password you signed up with.
login.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.description: An email and a password is all it takes. Your documents stay private to you.

confirmation.title: Check your inbox
confirmation.description: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it, then sign in.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first, then sign in.
errors.userExists: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.network: Can't reach the sign-in service. Check your connection and try again.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Everything you've added, ready to search and ask about.

list.noTags: No tags yet. Add them in the editor.
list.truncated: Only the {shown} most recently updated are listed and searched.

none.title: No documents yet
none.description: Write a note in Markdown or upload a text, Markdown or PDF file. Chat answers come from what you add here.

noMatches.title: No matching documents
noMatches.description: Nothing matches this search and tag selection. Try other words or clear the filters.

statusBar.label: Indexing status
statusBar.pending: Waiting to be indexed. Chat can use this document once it's ready.
statusBar.processing: Indexing now. This usually takes a few seconds.

ready.one: Indexed as {count} passage. Chat answers can cite it.
ready.other: Indexed as {count} passages. Chat answers can cite it.

statusBar.failed: Indexing failed. Chat can't use this document until it's indexed.

form.title: Title
form.tagsHint: Press Enter or comma to add a tag, up to {maximum}.

create.title: New document
create.description: Write or paste Markdown. It's indexed for chat as soon as you create it.

notFound.title: Document not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or the link is incomplete.

delete.title: Delete this document
delete.description: It's removed from search and chat right away. This can't be undone.
delete.confirmDescription: The document and its index are removed for good. Earlier chat answers keep the excerpts they quoted.

upload.title: Upload a file
upload.description: Its text becomes a new document, indexed for chat.
upload.dropzone: Choose a file or drag it here
upload.formats: TXT, Markdown or PDF, up to {maximum}

errors.unsupportedType: Only .txt, .md and .pdf files can be uploaded.
errors.unreadable: No usable text could be read from this file. It may be a scanned or protected PDF, not UTF-8 text, or longer than {characters} characters.

list.title: Conversations

empty.title: No conversations yet
empty.description: Ask a question and the conversation is saved here.

list.truncated: Only the {shown} most recent are listed.

delete.confirmDescription: The conversation and all of its answers are removed for good.

notFound.title: Conversation not found
notFound.description: It may have been deleted, or the link is incomplete.

empty.title: Ask your documents
empty.description: Answers are written from what you've added and cite the passages they rely on.
prompts: What are the key points across my documents?
List the deadlines and dates my documents mention.
What should a new team member read first?

noDocuments.title: Add a document to get started
noDocuments.description: Chat answers only from your own documents. Write a note or upload a file first.

composer.label: Message
composer.hint: Enter sends. Shift+Enter adds a new line.

pending.one: {count} document is still being indexed, so answers can't use it yet.
pending.other: {count} documents are still being indexed, so answers can't use them yet.

failed.one: {count} document couldn't be indexed and is left out:
failed.other: {count} documents couldn't be indexed and are left out:

finish.length: The answer reached its length limit.
finish.content_filter: The AI provider's content filter stopped this answer.
finish.error: An error cut this answer short.

errors.rateLimited: You've sent a lot of messages in a short time. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.providerUnavailable: The AI provider is unavailable right now. Try again in {seconds} s.
errors.interrupted: The connection dropped before the answer finished.
errors.conversationGone: This conversation no longer exists. Start a new chat to keep asking.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: Tokens used by chat and indexing over the last 30 days.

byDay.heading: Tokens by day
byDay.note: Days without usage are left out.

empty.title: No usage recorded yet
empty.description: Token counts show up here once a document is indexed or you ask a question.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: This page didn't load. Try again, and reload the page if it keeps happening.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.

errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimitedRetry: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} s.

codes.unauthenticated: Your session expired. Sign in again.
codes.forbidden: You don't have access to this.
codes.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.ai_provider_error: The AI provider returned an error. Try again.
codes.ai_provider_unavailable: The AI provider is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
codes.internal_error: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

validation.invalidOption: Choose one of the available options.
